From: T <timbuktom1@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, December 4, 2018 8:40 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Courageous Journalism! 
 
Your "Whatever" piece about Matt Moore, and your "Tigers Do Not Care About Wins" piece are pretty brave. You obviously are not trying to curry favor with Tigers management, aka, say, Joe Falls.
Thanks for your straight, realistic info. Tiger fans hate it, but we love reading it.
